definitions.clavicular head of pectoralis major musc: A muscle head that is the superior portion of the pectoralis major, originating from the anterior surface of the medial half of the clavicle and converging with the sternocostal head into a flat tendon inserted on the lateral lip of the intertubercular groove of the humerus; it is innervated by the lateral pectoral nerve (C5-C6) and acts to flex the humerus.
